intro.text: An Alethi master-servant who also runs messages and scouts for the coalition of monarchs.

items.text: The day the tower fell, Alili learned Teofil's last stand had failed and saw Navani with Raboniel; Navani told her the humans should not resist. Alili carried the surrender to every neighbourhood on the sixth floor, ending the day at Lirin's clinic, where over cold tea she argued that the war couldn't be over while the coalition's armies still fought.

She asked Kaladin whether he could help the other Radiants do what he had done, explaining he was the only one still awake. As she left, Syl warned of an approaching enemy soldier, and Alili passed a Regal on her way out.

appearance.text: Her hair is white and grey, prematurely so for her age. Running messages during the invasion, she wears a dishevelled uniform but keeps a master-servant's white gloves tucked into her belt.
